name: A0 Patient Decision Identifiability Audit seed42 v1

oracle.exhaustive: all distinct score-boundary decisions including extremes
oracle.tie_selection: minimum distance to original tau, then highest EZ-F1, then smallest decision-set index

oof.baseline_score: stored mean of 10 MC dropout passes, explicitly not deterministic full-FIT A0
oof.matching: exact raw 88D export/order/identities plus original teacher TRAIN-only preprocessor and exclusion provenance

lambda_selection: one P1/P2 pair within EACH outer fold, chosen on that fold's FIT-OOF uncertainty B8 query patient-mean macro-F1; tie stronger shrinkage; all five choices frozen before new VAL probes; never pool other folds' FIT labels into a target fold selection

solver.objective: mean BCE plus lambda/2 times squared norm including intercept

support.seeds: SHA256 of JSON [42,fold,patient,policy,repetition]; first 8 bytes little endian
support.permutation: one deterministic class-count-preserving permutation per episode

stats.cluster: unique patient ID; retain all patient-fold appearances
stats.estimand: equal patient-fold appearance mean; repeated support draws averaged within each cell first
stats.undefined_metrics: missing with contributing-cell and unique-ID denominators

gates.permutation: true P2 minus permuted P2 macro-F1 positive point and positive CI lower bound
gates.half_capacity: same direction or bias gate on matched half-support query; separate diagnostic, no absolute cross-budget comparison
